Players Committee high-resolution card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/reywithlightsaber_ai.png</code> in the PC's Holotable repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc 25e5dad] (10 August 2021, “Virtual AI pack series 2”), uploaded unchanged.
